annotation.authors_or_issuer: Dirección Nacional de Aviación Civil e Infraestructura Aeronáutica (DINACIA)
key_provisions_or_claims: Classifies remotely operated aerial devices by weight: minor (up to 25 kg), medium (25–260 kg), major/RPAS (over 260 kg).
Prohibits passenger transport, international operations, flight in restricted areas, over crowds and near airports without authorization.
Minor recreational devices need no registration or license but must stay below 120 m AGL, in VMC and visual line of sight.
Medium devices must be registered and operators obtain a DINACIA operator permit after an exam.
Paid operations are treated as aerial work, requiring liability or aeronautical insurance and case-by-case safety conditions.
annotation.summary_en: Uruguayan civil aviation authority (DINACIA) resolution of 29 August 2014 establishing interim basic rules for remotely operated aerial devices (drones). It classifies them by weight and sets prohibitions, registration, operator permits, altitude and visibility limits, and insurance for paid operations, pending detailed regulation.
annotation.title_clean: Resolución sobre Dispositivos Aéreos Operados a Distancia (drones)
annotation.title_en: Resolution on Remotely Operated Aerial Devices (Drones)
